rules.statement: The court may allow fresh issues to be formulated after the case has commenced if such a course appears to be in the interests of justice, even if these issues do not arise on the pleadings.
rules.supporting_quote: "No doubt it is a matter within the discretion of the Judge whether he will allow fresh issues to be formulated after the case has commenced, but he should do so when such a course appears to be in the interests of justice, and it is certainly not a valid objection to such a course being taken that they do not arise on the pleadings."
